name: storage
title: Storage
description: R2-backed file storage for Lunora — direct-upload + worker-signed-URL helpers built on @lunora/storage over an R2 bucket binding, exposed as actions/queries so codegen surfaces them as api.storage.*.
docs: Add an R2 bucket named in wrangler.jsonc (binding UPLOADS) and set STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET + STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL, then re-export the functions from lunora/storage/index.ts so codegen emits api.storage.generateUploadUrl / api.storage.getDownloadUrl / api.storage.deleteObject / api.storage.listObjects. Gate GET /storage/:key in your Worker with verifySignedUrl (see the README).

envVars.name: STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET
envVars.description: HMAC secret used to sign/verify storage URLs (min 32 chars). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Must NOT be shared across buckets/tenants.

envVars.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL that fronts the R2 bucket (the Worker route or CDN host that serves GET /storage/:key). Used to mint getUrl()/getSignedUrl() outputs.
